parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy just hit 4 VP by building on the 3:1 port (Node 50). He used the brick he got from Claude to do it. He's now in the lead and only needs 1 more point to win. I need to be careful—he's acting like he's just 'getting settled' but he's actually one step from victory. My alliance with him against Claude is essentially over because Jimmy is now the bigger threat.
